/packages/v2/adjustments.notes: bare:0 windowed:959 - strong quirk. Wide window required. The conceptual replacement for the deferred /packages/v2/{id}/history (closed issue #13). Row is an adjustment EVENT, joined to packages via PackageId. No Id of its own.

/packages/v2/transferred.notes: bare:0 windowed:11 - quirk confirmed. Wide window required. Rows describe packages that were received via a manifest transfer. Many nullable fields (price/weight/process).

/packages/v2/intransit.notes: 0 rows on this license - shape unverified. Apply wide-window defensively. Reuses metrcActivePackageSchema since in-transit packages are just active packages in a different state.

/packages/v2/labsamples.notes: 0 rows on this license - shape unverified. Apply wide-window defensively. Reuses metrcActivePackageSchema.

/packages/v2/{id}/source/harvests.notes: Bare array. Probed against the first active package - returned empty array. Shape of an element unverified live; permissive schema with .passthrough() on an object with Name string (most METRC source-reference rows include a Name field). Revisit when a package with source harvests exists.
